title: Spec Z is the final object of the category of schemes
statement: $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ is a terminal object of the category of schemes [def-pc-scheme]: for every scheme $X$ there is exactly one morphism of schemes $X\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$. In particular, for morphisms $a:Y\to S$ and $b:Y\to P$ of schemes the composites $Y\to S\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ and $Y\to P\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ agree, so $(a,b)$ always defines a morphism $Y\to S\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z}P$.
